counterexamples.evidence: The word "resource" reaches the model only through internal-only strings — board headings "## Board: projectedDeep (where the deep parity resource resolves — your line)" and "## Board: projectedDeepOpp (where the deep parity resource resolves — your opponent’s line)", plus the guardrail sentence "The deep resource resolves a long way out". The prompt’s explicit ban list ("Never repeat a field name, \"histogram\", \"window\", \"completing cell\", \"solver\", or \"score\"") does not cover it, so run 1 shipped "let your opponent’s later parity resource resolve faster" to the player. Fix is render-side: gloss those captions in player-safe words or add "resource" to the ban list.
